gloss: past and present; then and now

definitions.gloss: past and present; then and now
definitions.explanation: The contrast or comparison between how things were in the past and how they are now. Often used to reflect on changes over time.

examples.english: I feel a sense of how things have changed.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{今昔|こんじゃく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{堪|た}えない。
examples.english: Looking at this photo, I can't help but feel how much things have changed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{今昔|こんじゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{比較|ひかく}→比較：03576_hikaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めている→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: An exhibition comparing photos of Tokyo then and now is drawing crowds.

notes:
A literary compound expressing the contrast between past and present. Most commonly encountered in the set phrase {今昔|こんじゃく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ (a feeling of how times have changed) and in the title of the famous literary work {今昔|こんじゃく}{物語集|ものがたりしゅう}.

FORMS:
⟦{今|こん}→今〜：03952_kon⟧ (now, present) + {昔|じゃく} (past, old times). Note the on'yomi reading ⟦じゃ→じゃ：03040_ja⟧く for {昔|じゃく}, which differs from the common kun'yomi むかし.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {今昔|こんじゃく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧: a feeling of how times have changed — the most common usage
- {今昔|こんじゃく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{堪|た}えない: to be overwhelmed by the sense of change
- {今昔|こんじゃく}{物語集|ものがたりしゅう}: Konjaku Monogatari (a Heian-period collection of tales from Japan, China, and India)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧: the past, old times — everyday word
- {往時|おうじ}: the past, former days — literary
- {隔世|かくせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧: a sense of being in a different era — similar nuance to {今昔|こんじゃく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧
